spanish: No suban, porque no hay Jehová en medio de ustedes, y no sean heridos delante de sus enemigos.

findings.issue: לֹא plus niphal imperfect 2mp is future “no serán heridos”; “no sean heridos” makes it jussive like the preceding אַל + jussive.

notes: The other tokens match: jussive 2mp, כִּי, אֵין, Jehová, midst with 2mp, לִפְנֵי, and enemies with 2mp.
